contracts: (Exact-cover output contains forward and reverse entries for every Atomic Obligation/runtime-evidence pair and zero orphan diagnostics.) AND (The validator exits successfully only with an explicit zero-orphan result for the complete frozen set; any orphan causes failure.)
selector_intents: Remove the reverse edge from one runtime-evidence node while retaining its forward Atomic Obligation edge.
Run exact-cover orphan validation with at least one uncovered atomic obligation; validation must fail.
